name: enemies-r3
note: BL-17, owner's notes of 2026-11-12 (second round). The Zombie revised: both feet bare, the head held straight. The Demon as a new design: a floating half-bat (wings open, a small bat's lower body with little dangling legs), a fit upper body (r2 went chubby), arms crossed like a genie, tattoos on the arms, tall ridged lyre horns from the owner's reference photograph (_candidates/enemies-r3/refs/horns.png, not committed), a longer beard in two braids. One candidate each.

zombie.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture, no background). STYLE REFERENCE, the most important image: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game. The new creature must look drawn by the same hand on the same day, for the same storybook: the same chunky doll proportion (a big head, large expressive eyes, a short thick body, small feet), the same soft rendering; never realistic, never anatomical, never gory. THIS IS AN ENEMY the player fights: menacing in a storybook way (a scowl, bared teeth, a glare), but still charming and readable, something a child would call a monster and not be frightened by; no blood, no wounds. VIEW, the rule for every enemy (unlike this game's farm animals, which are drawn side-on): FRONT-FACING, like the player characters: upright and facing the viewer, the body square-ish to the viewer with a FAINT three-quarter turn, the head and the eyes turned a little toward the viewer's RIGHT, standing on ONE flat ground line, left and right sides roughly symmetrical, nothing trailing far outside the body's silhouette. SUBJECT: a shambling ZOMBIE with the reference character's build. DESIGN REFERENCE: the attached zombie is the FIRST drawing of this enemy: keep it exactly (the face, the hair, the skin colour, the tunic, the trousers, the pose of the arms) and make only TWO changes. CHANGE 1: BOTH feet are BARE: two grey-green bare feet with toes, the same on the left and the right; no boot, no shoe, no sock on either foot. CHANGE 2: the HEAD is held STRAIGHT and upright on the neck, level, not tilted and not cocked to either side; the neck is vertical. Otherwise as before: grey-green skin, sunken yellow eyes with small pupils, a slack open mouth with a few crooked teeth, lank dark hair, a ragged brown medieval peasant tunic with a torn hem and frayed sleeves and a rope belt, torn brown trousers, both arms stretched stiffly forward toward the viewer with the hands empty. Keep it at the game's scale: it is seen about 45 pixels wide on the board, so big plain shapes, a strong silhouette, flat areas of colour, no fine detail, no small accessories. COLOUR: bright and saturated; never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid, a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle (one board tile) and a dashed half-height box directly above it (the headroom); the reference character stands in that box with its head in the headroom. ONE FIGURE ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no building, no props on the ground, no scene. Draw it standing in the box, the same size as the reference character: feet on the box's bottom edge, head in the headroom. A soft contact shadow directly under it; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no frame, no text.

STYLE REFERENCE, the most important image: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game. SUBJECT: a FLOATING DEMON, half demon and half bat, a new design. FACE REFERENCE: the attached red demon is an earlier drawing of this enemy: keep its red face, its scowl, its yellow eyes and its fangs; everything else is redrawn as written here. HORNS REFERENCE: the attached photograph of a pair of dark red horns shows the horns to give it: two TALL horns that rise from the sides of the head in a wide lyre shape, sweeping outward, then curving inward, with the thin tips curling back outward at the top; ringed with ridges along their whole length; dark red-brown; each horn about as tall as the head. Copy the horns' SHAPE, drawn in this game's soft painted rendering, not as a photograph. HEAD: deep crimson-red skin, glowing yellow eyes under a heavy brow, a wide fanged grin, pointed ears, swept-back black hair, and a LONG black beard that hangs to the chest, gathered into TWO thin braids tied with small gold rings. UPPER BODY: bare-chested and FIT: an athletic build with a broad chest, firm shoulders and a flat stomach, drawn in simple smooth shapes; neither fat nor a bodybuilder: no belly, no bulging veined muscles. ARMS: both arms are CROSSED over the chest, folded like a genie's, each hand tucked at the opposite elbow; the hands hold NOTHING. Bold black TATTOOS on both upper arms and forearms: a few thick simple bands and curling flame shapes, big enough to read at small size. WINGS: two large charcoal BAT WINGS spread OPEN to both sides behind the shoulders, the membranes dark grey with a little dark red, about as wide again as the body on each side. LOWER BODY, like a bat: below the waist the body narrows quickly into a small dark furry bat's rump with two SHORT little legs that dangle, ending in small clawed feet, far too small to stand on; a thin tail with a spade tip curls beneath. It FLOATS: the little feet hang clearly ABOVE the ground with empty air under them, and its shadow lies on the ground below. Keep it at the game's scale: it is seen about 45 pixels wide on the board, so big plain shapes, a strong silhouette, flat areas of colour, no fine detail, no small accessories. COLOUR: bright and saturated; never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid, a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle (one board tile) and a dashed half-height box directly above it (the headroom); the reference character stands in that box with its head in the headroom. ONE FIGURE ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no building, no props on the ground, no scene. Draw it hovering over the box, bigger than the reference character: about one and a half times as tall from the horn tips to the dangling feet, the feet a little above the box's bottom edge, the horns near the top of the headroom; the open wings may spread well past the box's sides. A soft oval shadow on the ground directly below it, at the box's bottom edge, not touching the feet; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no frame, no text.
